raw_text: Tensions escalating in Nagaland over potential NSCN-IM ceasefire breakdown. Total shutdown called across multiple districts. Tribal organizations using encrypted messaging to coordinate road blockades. Assam Rifles deployments reported near Kohima and Dimapur. This could spiral into a major NE India security situation. #Nagaland #NSCNIM #Ceasefire
